en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Traditional humorous song, origin unclear; the boasts are mock-riches (frog's leg of silver, mouse-skin of wine). 'Кучке' is an insulting address (bitch) and 'од глувче меше' and 'едно рало гаќи' are my reading. 'Слекува' is dialect for taking clothes off.

lines.cyr: Ој Недо, Недо мори, земи ме, Недо.
lines.lat: Oj Nedo, Nedo mori, zemi me, Nedo.
lines.en: Oh Neda, Neda, hey, take me, Neda.
If you do not take me, Neda,
the wind will take you, bitch,
what fault did you find in me?

lines.cyr: Ние сме, Недо мори, луѓе чорбаџии,
lines.lat: Nie sme, Nedo mori, luǵe čorbadžii,
lines.en: We are, Neda dear, wealthy men,

lines.cyr: Од жаба нога, Недо, целата срма,
lines.lat: Od žaba noga, Nedo, celata srma,
lines.en: From a frog's leg, Neda, all the silver embroidery,

lines.cyr: од глувче меше Недо, полно је со вино.
lines.lat: od gluvče meše Nedo, polno je so vino.
lines.en: from a mouse's skin, Neda, it is full of wine.

lines.cyr: И ние сме Недо мори, луѓе чорбаџии,
lines.lat: I nie sme Nedo mori, luǵe čorbadžii,
lines.en: And we too, Neda dear, are wealthy men,

lines.cyr: едно рало гаќи, Недо, деветмина браќа,
lines.lat: edno ralo gaḱi, Nedo, devetmina braḱa,
lines.en: one plough's worth of trousers, Neda, nine brothers,

lines.cyr: едниот ги слеква, Недо, другиот ги облеква.
lines.lat: edniot gi slekva, Nedo, drugiot gi oblekva.
lines.en: one takes them off, Neda, the other puts them on.
